lines.t: Broken house, broken mind, but still breathing.
YahuShua… this one’s Yours.
I should be dead in this madness, but I’m still here, still standin’
Grace pulled me out of that bottle, out the fog, out the cannons
Heart cracked open like granite, mind still bruised, still damaged
So I lay what’s left on the altar, let the Lion do the slayin’Kratom claws in my veins, bipolar storm in my brain
But He walks in the fire with me, calls me out by my name
I ain’t strong, I’m shattered, I ain’t clean, I’m stained
But I bow in the middle of the war, and His mercy still reigns
She left me and the kids in the doorway, no goodbye, just silence
Vows fell down like rubble, turned love into sirens
Two kids on my chest, tryna swallow my violence
Not with fists, but with demons in my thoughts, in my silenceI drowned pain in the liquor, every shot, new chain
Every night blacked out, every dawn more shame
Screamed at the ceiling, “You saw this, explain!”
But He kept me breathing when I spit in His name

Twenty years in the dark, untreated rage in my chest
Riding maniac highs, then the lows with no rest
Kratom felt like a friend, but it owned my breath
Withdrawal like thunder, every nerve near deathSweat cold, hands shaking, skin crawling with ghosts
Voices in my head raising wicked toasts
“I’ll never be free” was the hook I loved most
But His whisper cut through, louder than the host“Child, I see every tremor, every tear on your face,
I was there in the pit, I’m not leaving this place.”
He didn’t wait ‘til I was clean, didn’t ask for my show
He stepped in the chaos and refused to let go
I should be dead in this madness, but I’m still here, still standin’

If I run, He follows, if I fall, He stays
If I rage, He listens, if I doubt, He saves
My mind ain’t steady, but His love don’t fade
My strength is broken, but His power invades
I’m a dad with a brain that’s been torn by the fight
Trying to lead two kids with a flickering light
Bandwidth low, but I’m giving Him my “yes” tonight
“YahuShua, take the wheel, let Your will ignite.”He knew every fracture in my mind’s design
All the bottles, all the binges, every crooked line
Still He wrote my name down before there was time
Now I fall on my face, let His mercy define
